name: ai-subtitle-generator
description: AI-powered web application that converts video and audio into multilingual subtitles

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "backend,frontend" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.start: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "backend,frontend" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm run start --prefix backend" "npm run preview --prefix frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && npm install
